verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The convex-combination form itself is stated by no declaration; Lean states the equivalent pair correctedSpeed δ v = v + correction δ v (definition) and correction δ v = ζ²(v_* − v) (correction_formula, for 0 < δ), from which v + ζ²(v_* − v) = (1 − ζ²)v + ζ²v_* by `ring`. The rearrangement is the one the Lean proofs use regime by regime: ζ = 1 gives v = v_* (correctedSpeed_gt_two, line 111), ζ ≠ 0 gives v ≤ v_* (correctedSpeed_le_target_of_active) together with v_s ≤ v (correction_nonneg), and ζ = 0 gives v = v_s (correction_zero) — the paper's three cutoff regimes displayed just below this line.
